effects.printed_clause: During the Main Phase: You can Special Summon 1 Zombie monster from your Spell & Trap Zone.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect restricted to Main Phase finds a face-up original Monster Zombie in the controller's Spell & Trap Zone and Special Summons it.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summons a Monster Card from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Main Phase self-Special-Summon from Continuous-Trap state.

effects.printed_clause: If your opponent Special Summons a monster from the Extra Deck: You can place 1 face-up monster you control in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap, then target 1 monster your opponent controls.
effects.lua_implementation: At activation, the cost callback performs the pre-semicolon placement action and the target callback then selects the opposing monster; resolution moves that target if it remains related.

official_references.matched_structure: Places a controlled monster as a face-up Continuous Trap.
Moves/sends controller cards as activation cost before choosing opponent cards.
Targets a face-up Monster Card in a Spell & Trap Zone using standard pre-resolution targeting.

effects.issue: Rejected: the exact text places both 'place ... then target ...' after the colon and before the semicolon. They are activation procedures, and Omega encodes non-target activation actions in the cost callback before target selection.

effects.printed_clause: Place the targeted opponent monster in your opponent's Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: Resolution moves the still-related opponent target to their Spell & Trap Zone face-up and registers TYPE_TRAP+TYPE_CONTINUOUS.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Crewal Attack once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The Main Phase summon and Extra Deck summon response use id and id+100 hard once-per-turn keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Separate hard once-per-turn effects for zone-transition operations.

coverage_override.reason: Four records cover Main Phase summon, activation placement/target procedure, opposing placement resolution, and per-effect HOPT.
